spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (वर्कते)
To take or accept.

m. (-कः)
1 A wolf.
2 A crow.
3 The Vakapushpa tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.)
4 A

Shakal.
5

Turpentine.
6

Compounded perfume.
f. (-का)
A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
E.
वृक to take, aff. क, or वृ to hide or screen, Uṇādi aff. कक्.

m. (-शः)
A dog.
E.
वृक a wolf, and दंश who bites.

m. (-पः)
1 Compounded perfume.
2 Turpentine.
E.
वृक the same meanings, and धूप incense.

m. (-तिः)
A dog.
E.
वृक a wolf, and अराति an enemy.

m. (-रिः)
A dog.
E.
वृक a wolf, and अरि an enemy.

m. (-रः)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2

Name of BHĪMA.
E.
वृक a wolf, and उदर the belly.

mfn. (-क्णः-क्णा-क्णं)
Cut, divided, broken.
E.
व्रश्च to cut, aff. क्त, form irr.; also read वृक्न.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Cutting, severing.
E.
व्रश्च to cut, क्तवतु aff.

r. 1st cl. (वृक्षते)
1 To appoint.
2 To cover.
3 To take or accept.

m. (-क्षः)
A tree in general.
E.
वृक्ष to cover, (to shade,) aff. घञ् or व्रश्च to cut, and स Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A small tree, (Wrightea antidysenterica.)
2 Any tree.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-टः)
A wild cock.
E.
वृक्ष, and कुक्कुट a cock.

n. (-ण्डं)
A grove.
E.
वृक्ष, and खण्ड a part.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Going or living in trees.
m. (-रः)
A monkey.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, or any other synonym, and चर who goes.

f. (-या)
The shade of a single tree.
n. (-यं)
The shade of many trees, or a grove.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, and छाया shade; in the second sense, it takes the neuter gender.

n. (-लं)
The foot of a tree or ground about it.
E.
वृक्ष, and तल below.

m. (-पः)
Turpentine.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, and धूप incense.

m. (-थः)
The Indian fig tree.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, and नाथ lord.

m. (-सः)
Gum, resin.
E.
वृक्ष, and निर्य्यास exudation.

m. (-सः)
Dwelling or living in a tree.
E.
वृक्ष, and निवास abode.

m. (-कः)
The Indian fig tree.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, and पाक what ripens or perfects.

n. (-नं)
A hollow in a tree.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, and भवन a dwelling.

f. (-भिद् or -भित्)
An axe.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, and भिद् breaking, cutting.

m. (-दी)
1 A carpenter's chisel.
2 A hatchet.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, and भेदिन् what breaks.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Abounding with trees.
E.
वृक्ष, and मयट् aff.

f. (-का)
A squirrel.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, मर्कट a monkey, कन् aff. of comparison.

m. (-द्भूः)
A sort of cane or reed, (Calamus fascicularis.)
E.
वृक्ष a tree, मृद् earth, and भू born.

mf. (-हः-हा)
A parasite plant, (Cymbidum tessalloides, &c.)
E.
वृक्ष, and रुह growing, having its roots attached to the trunk or branches of another plant or tree.

n. (-ण)
Planting trees.
E.
वृक्ष, and रोपण planting; also वृक्षारोपण.

n. (-णं)
Planting trees.
E.
वृक्ष, and आरोपण planting.

f. (-का)
A garden, a grove, one belonging to the residence of a minister of state, a courtezan, &c.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, and वाटिका or वाटी an enclosure; hence also वृक्षवाटी.

m. (-शः)
A lizard, a chamæleon.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, and शी to sleep, aff. ड.

f. (-का)
A squirrel.
E.
वृक्ष, शी to sleep, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
What is or stays in or on a tree.
E.
वृक्ष, and स्थ who or what stays, also वृक्षस्थायिन्, वृक्षस्थित, &c.

n. (-ग्रं)
The top of a tree.
E.
वृक्ष, and अग्र top.

m. (-ङ्घ्रिः)
The root of a tree.
E.
वृक्ष, and अङ्घ्रि foot.

m. (-नः)
1 A carpenter's chisel or adze.
2 A hatchet, a chopper.
3 The Indian fig tree.
4 The Piyāl tree, (Buchanania latifolia.)
f. (-नी)
1 A parasite plant, (Epidendron.)
2 A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)
E.
वृक्ष a tree, अदन eating or food.

n. (-कं)
Embracing.
E.
वृक्षादि trees, &c., रुह ascended, and कन् aff. of comparison; entwining as a creeper round a tree, &c.; also derived from रुह with क्त aff. वृक्षादिरूढ n. (-ढं).

m. (-म्लः)
The hog plum, (Spondias mangifera.)
n. (-म्लं)
Acid seasoning, or the fruit of the tamarind so used.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, and अम्ल sour.

m. (-कः)
A planter of a tree.
E.
वृक्ष, and आरोपक who plants.

m. (-यः)
A bird in general.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, and आलय abode.

m. (-सः)
1 An ascetic, one who lives in the hollows of trees.
2 A bird.
E.
वृक्ष a tree, आवास abode.

mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं)
Growing on or borne by a tree.
E.
वृक्ष, and उत्थ what rises.

m. (-लः)
A large handsome tree, commonly Kaniyar or Karṇikāra, (Pterospermum acerifolium.)
E.
वृक्ष a tree, and उत्पल a lotus.
